title: Chase overdue invoices

outputs.destination: Sent from the accounts inbox to each customer 7–29 days overdue

steps.action: Send the friendly reminder email, with the invoice attached, for each invoice 7 to 29 days overdue
Phone the customer for each invoice 30 or more days overdue
Note the outcome of each call against the invoice

decisionPoints.condition: The invoice is over $2,000 and more than 45 days overdue
decisionPoints.action: Don't contact the customer; pass it to Dana, who decides between the debt collector and a call

decisionPoints.condition: The customer says they've already paid
decisionPoints.action: Check the payment has been received before contacting them again

qualityChecks: Every invoice 7–29 days overdue on Monday's report has a reminder email in the accounts inbox Sent folder dated that Monday
Every invoice over $2,000 and 45+ days overdue has a note that it was passed to Dana

escalation.when: An invoice is over $2,000 and more than 45 days overdue
A customer mentions a lawyer, a tribunal or a debt collector
A customer disputes the bill instead of paying
